body: Special City Council Meeting - State of The City meeting
agenda_text:
NOTICE AND AGENDA
  FOR SPECIAL MEETING

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor of the City of Norwalk has called a special meeting of the City
Council beginning at 12:00 p.m. on October 16, 2026, at the Norwalk Arts and Sports Complex, 13000 Clarkdale
Avenue, Norwalk. To watch the meeting and provide live comments on the agenda items during the meeting,
join Zoom by using the link: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84714964101 or dialing (408) 638-0968. The agenda for
the special meeting is as follows:

CALL TO ORDER  Mayor Jennifer Perez

INVOCATION  Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager

FLAG SALUTE  Ozzie Ramos, Deputy City Manager

ROLL CALL  City Clerk

PRESENTATIONS

1. State of the City, Mayor Perez
2. Norwalk Chamber of Commerce, Caren Spilsbury
3. Norwalk Sheriff’s Station, Captain Omar Camacho

PUBLIC COMMENTS (As this is a special meeting, members of the public are entitled to speak only on the items
listed.)

Dated this 13th day of October 2026.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk

I, Theresa Devoy, City Clerk, hereby certify that the foregoing notice of special meeting was posted at City Hall not less than
24-hours before the start of the meeting and delivered to each member of the Norwalk City Council and to the following
newspapers: Herald American, Cerritos Community News, Norwalk Patriot, and Whittier Daily News, all on the 13th day of
October 2026.

 Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it has been
 posted will also be made available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s Department.

 Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the City Council on any matter listed on the agenda.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
 meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
 devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
 documents in the agenda packet, can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
 Notification of at least 12 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
 that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
